reviewFlags.issue: Catalog says 2760mAh for the 21.6V battery; pompa.co.il lists 30000mah for the same battery, which is implausible for this pack. Confirm the capacity with the importer before publishing.
Catalog brand is misspelled 'Hemilton Beach'; every exact-model page says Hamilton Beach.
21,000Pa is not on any exact-model page found. A forum post claims 21,000 vs 18,000 for another model; that is a user claim, not evidence.

No exact-model dimensions or weight found. soferavi.co.il lists base 33 x 33 cm and height with tube 116 cm, but it names only 14326-IS without the Q12 suffix, so it was not used. Verify before publishing.
Warranty sources conflict: pompa.co.il lists 24 months; soferavi.co.il lists 2 years in its spec but 1 year retailer warranty. Not published. Confirm with the importer.
Run time, charge time and tank capacities could not be read reliably from an exact-model page (pompa.co.il text is garbled in the fetch output; zap.co.il has no such spec lines). Not published.
HEPA filtration and cyclone details in the catalog were not confirmed on an exact-model page.
